descriptionMarkdown:
All these mounts count as Heavy and Emplaced, resolved using 21.3. The heavy stubber, heavy bolter and multi-laser 
retain Chapter 8 damage, range and other properties. Range is in feet; two numbers mean normal/maximum range. A 
single area range is the furthest point the gunner may choose.
Weapon Damage Range Properties Availability
Heavy stubber 1d12 piercing 120/360 Burst, Suppression; Reload 40 Controlled
Heavy bolter 1d12 piercing + 1d6 
thunder 100/300 Burst, Brutal, Suppression; Reload 30 Scarce
Multi-laser 2d8 radiant 120/360 Burst; Reload 40 Scarce
Autocannon 2d10 piercing 160/480 Armour-Breaking; Reload 10 Rare
Lascannon 4d10 radiant 200/600 Armour-Breaking; Reload 5 Rare
Battle cannon 3d10 piercing + 3d10 
thunder 240 15-ft radius; Armour-Breaking; Reload 1 Exceptional
Bolt cannon 3d8 piercing 120/360 Burst, Brutal; Reload 12 Rare
HYLas rotary cannon 3d8 radiant 120/360 Burst; Reload 20 Rare
Magna-coil autocannon 3d10 piercing 160/480 Armour-Breaking; Reload 8 Rare
Scatter laser 3d8 radiant 160/480 Burst; Reload 24 Rare
Shuriken cannon 2d10 slashing 120/360 Burst, Monomolecular; Reload 18 Rare
Twin shuriken catapults 1d8 slashing 60/180 Burst, Monomolecular, Twin-Linked; 
Reload 24 Scarce
Pulse laser 4d10 radiant 200/600 Armour-Breaking; Reload 6 Exceptional
Battle cannon: choose a visible point within 240 ft. Creatures and vehicles within 15 ft make Dexterity saves against 
the gunner’s mounted save DC, taking full damage on failure or half on success. Full Cover blocks the blast. Apply 
Armour-Breaking and DT after the save. No attack roll, critical hit or Dexterity damage modifier applies. Spend one 
shell; reloading loads one from the eight-shell mission supply.
Burst uses the Chapter 7 −2 attack penalty and extra damage die. It expends three shots instead of one and 
requires at least three remaining. For mixed dice, an extra Burst or Brutal die is the first damage die listed. 
Area weapons cannot use Burst. A Suppression mount may require one creature it hits to make a Wisdom save 
against the mounted save DC; failure applies Suppressed as in 6.3. Hulls are immune.
Reload X is the current magazine’s remaining firing uses; Burst consumes three. An action by the gunner or loader fills 
it to X from compatible stores. Ordinary spare magazines are abstracted unless scarcity was declared; battle cannon 
shells are always counted. This list does not grant additional mounts.
Loadout options: with GM approval, replace a Sentinel multi-laser with a lascannon or a Vyper scatter laser with a 
shuriken cannon. Retain stations and firing limits. A pulse laser needs a suitable heavy Aeldari chassis and is not a 
normal Vyper upgrade.
Damage example: a heavy bolter hits a Chimera (DT 10) for 8 piercing + 5 thunder. The combined 13 meets DT, so 
apply all 13 HP damage. A separate 9-damage hit does nothing. Armour-Breaking instead compares damage with DT 
5. Passengers are not automatically damaged.
